sentences.en: Criticism of "elitism" is often a veiled attack on intellectualism.
sentences.zh: 批评‘精英主义’往往是对智识的一种隐含攻击。

sentences.en: Criticism of "elitism" is often a veiled form of anti-intellectualism.
sentences.zh: 批评‘精英主义’常常是以反智的形式出现。

sentences.en: She made a veiled reference to his lack of education.
sentences.zh: 她含蓄地提到了他缺乏教育背景一事。
